props.caption: Abu Dhabi. The talks covered humanitarian and security issues in the war.

lead.what: Russian, Ukrainian and U.S. delegations held their first U.S.-mediated talks in nine months in Abu Dhabi.

rest.what: A second day was scheduled for Wednesday.

lead.what: The House voted 211–204 to send Thomas Massie’s impeachment resolution against Pete Hegseth to committee.
Bulgaria declared Wednesday a day of national mourning following the incident.
